t: What passing in front of someone praying costs
a: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمَارُّ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الْمُصَلِّي مَاذَا عَلَيْهِ لَكَانَ أَنْ يَقِفَ أَرْبَعِينَ خَيْرًا لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
p: Law yaʿlamu-l-mārru bayna yaday-l-muṣallī mādhā ʿalayhi la-kāna an yaqifa arbaʿīna khayran lahu min an yamurra bayna yadayh
m: If the one who passes in front of a person praying knew what it costs him, standing still for forty would be better for him than passing in front of him.
